title: Zephyr safety configs CONFIG_THREAD_ANALYZER* + CONFIG_SYS_HEAP_VALIDATE absent from all prj.conf (spec appendix-c R-APPC-007/008)
description: spec/appendix-c-safety.md R-APPC-007/008 (Zephyr Safety Config, Mandatory): 'All firmware builds MUST enable in prj.conf: CONFIG_THREAD_ANALYZER=y, CONFIG_THREAD_ANALYZER_USE_PRINTK=y, CONFIG_THREAD_ANALYZER_AUTO=n (CI and debug builds); CONFIG_SYS_HEAP_VALIDATE=y (debug builds).' Sweep classification: not-implemented — zero hits repo-wide (rg over lichen/ and firmware/ .conf/Kconfig for CONFIG_THREAD_ANALYZER* and CONFIG_SYS_HEAP_VALIDATE). The other flags from the same MUST sentence are present: CONFIG_STACK_CANARIES/SENTINEL/ASSERT/ASSERT_VERBOSE in lichen/apps/gateway/prj.conf:54-57, lichen/apps/puck/prj.conf:62-65, firmware/bridge-zephyr/prj.conf:40-43, lichen/tests/util/prj.conf:10-13. Ambiguity flagged for Opus: the spec block itself qualifies thread analyzer with '(CI and debug builds)' and heap validate with '(debug builds)' — if those qualifiers scope the MUST to test/debug configs, app prj.confs are conformant and this bead narrows to test-config enablement. Suggested placement: lichen/tests prj.confs + a debug overlay, or app prj.confs if the MUST is ruled unconditional. Full row in docs/spec-coverage.md (spec/appendix-c-safety.md sweep 2026-08-31).
close_reason: DONE: R-APPC-007/008 Zephyr safety configs landed across ALL 78 test prj.conf files (commit 5c2f91988f): CONFIG_THREAD_ANALYZER=y + CONFIG_THREAD_ANALYZER_USE_PRINTK=y + CONFIG_THREAD_ANALYZER_AUTO=n (spec: 'CI and debug builds' — the test suite IS the CI set) + CONFIG_SYS_HEAP_VALIDATE=y (debug builds). Files that already carried the analyzer trio (76 of 78, from the earlier util/prj.conf rollout) got only the missing SYS_HEAP_VALIDATE; gnss_l76k (the one file with neither) got both blocks. VERIFIED: native_sim build of tests/coap_config generates .config with CONFIG_SYS_HEAP_VALIDATE=y and the app boots; THREAD_ANALYZER correctly does NOT appear on native_sim because the Zephyr Kconfig gates it 'depends on !ARCH_POSIX' (subsys/debug/Kconfig:11) — it takes effect on hardware CI boards (nrf52840/esp32 targets), which is the intended scope. All three analyzer symbols confirmed to exist in the pinned Zephyr tree (THREAD_ANALYZER/USE_PRINTK/AUTO). RESIDUALS (not gating, tracked): (1) the -Werror waiver promotion for conversion/cast-align is the separate long-burn item in this bead's original text (blocked on upstream Zephyr/nrfx header cleanliness — the spec 'NO WAIVERS' preamble cannot be satisfied until upstream is clean); (2) CONFIG_STACK_CANARIES routing-through-Kconfig vs literal -fstack-protector-strong spec ratification is a spec-text edit for Mark; (3) the apps' prj.conf deliberately do NOT carry THREAD_ANALYZER (production builds are neither CI nor debug per the spec qualifier).
